evidence_shape.excerpt: short supporting paraphrase, not a long quotation

rules: Use actual public evidence, not model memory or previous candidate submissions
Each populated decision field must map to evidence or be explicitly unresolved
Do not claim account/API execution when only documentation was reviewed
Composio catalogue presence does not imply an official vendor MCP
Unresolved MCP is not proof of nonexistence
Use original assigned app identity and disambiguate consumer versus enterprise variants
Browser-assisted agent checks are automated, never human
